base_model_option.description: Base Model option to be used (default = "pre-trained"), you can either start from the pure base model (pre-trained) or from any checkpoint for your fine-tuned model (fine-tuned)

base_model.description: The base model to fine-tune. To see full list of supported base model please visit [Base Models](/fine-tuning/parameters#available-base-models). If you are training on fine-tuned base model option, specify the training job name you want to use.

checkpoint.description: (Required if base_model_option == "fine-tuned"), specify the checkpoint you want to use.

train_dataset_id.description: The training dataset ID to use for fine-tuning

items.description: Name of test function to be used

test_dataset_id.description: The testing dataset ID to use for fine-tuning (optional)

train_test_split_ratio.description: The ratio (%) to split the training dataset for testing (optional)

name.description: The name of the training job (optional)

description.example: Fine-tuning the model on my dataset
description.description: A description of the training job (optional)

task_type.description: The task type for the training job (default = "text-generation")

hf_model_link.description: Link to the Hugging Face model / Use only when you use the HF_MODEL as a base
